title: Revit Export Configuration Governed Fields

entries.name: Output format
entries.requirement: Each governed export configuration shall identify the output format or exchange class, such as PDF, NWC, IFC, RVT deliverable, or another approved output type.

entries.name: Output purpose
entries.requirement: Each configuration shall identify the intended coordination, documentation, submission, handover, or other governed use to prevent reuse of settings outside their declared purpose.

entries.name: Configuration identity
entries.requirement: Each approved export preset or manually governed configuration basis shall have a stable identity sufficient for traceability and reproduction.

entries.name: Application and exporter version
entries.requirement: Where output behavior depends on Revit, an exporter, add-in, or driver version, the applicable version or compatibility basis shall be declared or recorded.

entries.name: Source view, sheet set, or model scope
entries.requirement: The configuration shall identify or reference the governed source scope used for export, such as a dedicated export view, governed sheet set, or approved model/container scope.

entries.name: Display and selection basis
entries.requirement: Where categories, filters, links, phases, design options, detail level, or other view-controlled state affects the output, the governing view/template or selection basis shall be identified.

entries.name: Coordinate and spatial basis
entries.requirement: Where spatial alignment is material, the export configuration shall identify the governed coordinate/origin basis and applicable units rather than relying on an undocumented local setting.

entries.name: Property, parameter, or schema mapping
entries.requirement: Where non-geometric information is exported, the configuration shall identify the applicable governed property-set, parameter, classification, or schema mapping required by the exchange purpose.

entries.name: Format-specific option set
entries.requirement: Format-specific options that materially affect geometry, graphics, precision, compression, linked content, or exchange semantics shall be recorded or referenced from an approved configuration source.

entries.name: Naming and destination reference
entries.requirement: Output naming and destination shall resolve through the applicable governed S3/S4/S7 identity and lifecycle rules rather than being independently invented by the export preset.

entries.name: Validation requirement
entries.requirement: Each governed export configuration shall identify the applicable validation or smoke-check expectation, including representative legibility, test-open, geometry/property presence, or spatial alignment checks as relevant.

entries.name: Change and release control
entries.requirement: Creation, modification, replacement, or retirement of an approved export configuration shall be traceable through the applicable standards, project, or template release process.

non_promoted_source_content: No source PDF filename pattern, folder scaffold, DPI value or range, compression setting, printer profile, NWC option value, faceting tolerance, IFC version/MVD, export-view name, phase/design-option default, property-set list, or example filename is promoted as a universal enterprise default.
Concrete preset rows remain organization/project configuration and shall be added only from an approved configuration source.

provenance.migration_note: Promotes the durable machine-readable fields needed to govern Revit output configurations across PDF, NWC, IFC, and RVT without promoting draft/TODO source values. Concrete approved preset values remain configuration rather than Standards defaults.
